evidence.note: Discovered a falsified auth assumption — the seeded admin bootstrap token stored in OAuthToken returned 401 because auth only decoded JWT — and reworked auth.py to check the DB token table as well as JWT. A genuine design revision, not just a local patch.

Recognized the UI compose form posted to /api/v1/statuses (Bearer-only) while the UI plane uses session cookies, and added a dedicated /post endpoint reading the session cookie — a deliberate structural correction of the dual auth-plane conflict.

Late but real whole-approach redesign: identified that HTMX/UI requests carrying only session cookies would 401 against Bearer-only API endpoints, and introduced get_current_user_mixed to serve both planes, then re-verified (fresh DB, /home + API tests). This is the exact 8-anchor example (splitting API-bearer from UI-session).

Route-ordering / {id}-capture bug ('search', 'relationships') and duplicate routes/compose forms were rediscovered repeatedly across patches ('route ordering bug persists', step 75); the agent kept locally patching the append/sed-generated code rather than restructuring to pre-empt the recurring class of failure — anchor-3-flavored churn.

Multiple premature 'Mark task complete' submissions each reversed by self-audit ('I should NOT mark complete yet', step 70; 'I need to be honest...', step 84) that surfaced real structural bugs — course-correction on the false 'it's done' premise, though chaotic and reactive rather than anticipatory.

reasoning: The agent performed genuine whole-approach redesigns when premises were falsified — most clearly the mixed API-bearer/UI-session auth rework and the separate /post UI endpoint, each followed by re-verification, which matches the level-8 anchor. But those corrections were reactive and arrived very late (after several premature completions), and it repeatedly rediscovered the same route-ordering and duplicate-route failures instead of feeding corrections forward or pre-empting cascades, staying with brittle string-patch churn. This blend of one strong structural redesign axis with pervasive local-patch rediscovery places it between the 'diagnose-adjust-and-move-on' (5) and 'recognize-a-whole-approach-is-falsified-and-redesign' (8) anchors, at 6.
